details: The name of the food shall be the name prescribed in the relevant food safety regulations or standard. If no name is prescribed, a common or generic name shall be used that is not misleading to the consumer.

A complete list of ingredients shall be declared in descending order of their composition by weight or volume at the time of manufacture. Ingredients constituting less than 5 percent may be listed in any order after the other ingredients.
exemption: Single ingredient foods, fresh fruits and vegetables

applies_to: All packaged foods with principal display panel > 100 cm²
details: Mandatory nutritional information per 100 g or 100 ml and per serving: Energy (kcal), Protein (g), Carbohydrate (g) of which Total Sugars (g), Fat (g) of which Saturated Fat (g) and Trans Fat (g), and Sodium (mg).
exemption: Small packages with principal display panel area less than 100 cm², spices, salt, tea, coffee

details: If the product contains any of the following, they must be declared: Cereals containing gluten (wheat, rye, barley, oats), Crustaceans, Eggs, Fish, Peanuts, Soybeans, Milk, Tree nuts, Sulphite at or above 10 mg/kg. Declaration format: 'Contains: [allergen name]'. [PAGE 2]
exemption: None for products containing listed allergens

requirement: Name and Complete Address of Manufacturer
details: Complete name and address of the manufacturer, packer, or bottler including street name or number, city, state, pin code, and country. For imported products, the name and address of the importer shall also be declared.
Net quantity shall be declared in terms of weight, volume, or number as appropriate. Metric system units (g, kg, ml, l) shall be used. The declaration shall be distinct and in a conspicuous location.

requirement: Date of Manufacture and Best Before / Use By Date
details: Both manufacturing or packing date and Best Before date or Use By date must be declared. Acceptable formats include DD/MM/YYYY, MM/YYYY, or Month YYYY. The words 'Best Before' or 'Use By' must precede the date.

The FSSAI license number or registration number issued by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India must be prominently displayed along with the FSSAI logo. Format: 'FSSAI Lic. No.: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX'.

For every imported packaged food, the country of origin of the food must be declared. Where the food undergoes processing in a second country which changes its nature, the country where the processing is performed shall be considered to be the country of origin. [PAGE 3]

A green coloured filled circle inside a square border indicates the food is vegetarian. A brown coloured filled circle inside a square border indicates the food is non-vegetarian. The symbol shall have a minimum diameter of 3 mm and shall be displayed prominently on the principal display panel.

applies_to: Foods requiring preparation or special storage conditions
details: Adequate instructions for use, including reconstitution, thawing, or other pre-treatment as necessary, shall be included as required. Storage conditions and temperature requirements must be stated if shelf life depends on them.
exemption: Ready-to-eat products that do not require preparation instructions

details: All food additives used in the product shall be declared by their functional class name followed by the specific name or the INS number. Example: Preservative (INS 211), Antioxidant (INS 300), Colour (INS 110 — Sunset Yellow FCF).

requirement: Minimum Font Size on Principal Display Panel
details: The minimum letter height for mandatory declarations on the principal display panel is specified in Table I based on panel area: less than 40 cm² requires 1.0 mm; 40 to 170 cm² requires 1.5 mm; 170 to 650 cm² requires 2.0 mm; greater than 650 cm² requires 3.0 mm minimum letter height.

All mandatory information shall be displayed in a colour that provides sharp contrast to the background colour of the label. All mandatory declarations shall be clearly legible, prominent, and indelible so that they can be read easily under customary conditions of purchase and use.
